text:
ben-ml: heads-up — we started a 5% canary of v2p2-int4 on chat/summarize and are seeing traffic oscillation vs control (latency/throughput stable but quality signal bouncing). wondering if we should pause and add hysteresis.
carla-eng: any quick numbers? sample size, metrics that are oscillating?
deploy-bot: rollout event: canary start 2943219800, variant=v2p2-int4, traffic=5%, region=us-west-2
ben-ml: baseline -> control (v2p1-fp16). After ~30m canary, delta(quality_composite) is noisy: +0.2% then -0.6% then +0.1% in 10m windows. sample sizes per window ~300-400 requests, mostly long-form summarization.
alice: that volatility screams underpowered sampling + short aggregation windows. two quick knobs: longer smoothing (half-life) or a cooldown between traffic steps. recommend cooldown=30m and min_samples=2000 before promotion.
eva-research: dug into evals: int4 shows small degradation on long-form Rouge-L / entailment slices. quick snapshot from shadow compare (1000 examples):
```
metric      control  int4   delta
ROUGE-L     0.612    0.605  -0.007
Entailment  0.881    0.872  -0.009
Perplexity  18.4     19.0   +0.6
CompositeQ   1.000   0.993  -0.007
```
Most of regression concentrated on >1024 token summaries and prompts with many context-switches.
frank: propose an autofallback rule: if CompositeQ drops >=0.5% with p<0.05 over a rolling 2k sample OR if KL(control||canary)>0.03 on distribution of next-token probs -> immediate fallback to control and cool down for 1h.
carla-eng: where do we compute CompositeQ? is that in production telemetry or post-hoc evals?
eva-research: CompositeQ is an online score we derive from weighted ROUGE-L, entailment, and user-regens. it's stored per-request in telemetry bucket (aggregated 1m). we can expose it to rollouts service.
ben-ml: we should also add a hysteresis window to avoid flip-flopping: require two consecutive passing windows (each 30m) before increasing traffic. And on rollback require 3 consecutive failing windows or a single catastrophic trigger (like regen-rate spike >5%).
alice: here's a draft rollout gate snippet we can push to config:
```
policy:
  min_samples: 2000
  step_cooldown: 1800   # seconds
  smoothing_half_life: 3600
  promote_condition:
    consecutive_pass_windows: 2
    window_size: 1800
  rollback_triggers:
    - composite_delta_pct: -0.5
      p_value_threshold: 0.05
      sample_window: 2000
    - kl_threshold: 0.03
    - regen_rate_pct: 5
```
carla-eng: looks good. will need rollout service changes to enforce consecutive windows + sample gating. i can pick this up today.
frank: also: add a small floor check for latency tail (p99 < 2x baseline) to avoid perf regressions hiding behind quality signals.
rollouts-bot: acknowledged. enqueuing job update: rollout-policy v0.21 -> apply to canary group for v2p2-int4
ben-ml: one more: add an alert to SRE/triage when canary oscillation detected (delta sign flips twice within 1h) — human review required before auto-promotion after oscillation.
carla-eng: got it. will add alert and the config changes. scheduling a canary hold now while we patch the rollout policy.
alice: for the record i'll run a targeted offline eval for >1024 token slice to try to quantify perplexity vs hallucination tradeoffs.
ben-ml: perfect — thanks. if eva's slice shows concentrated regressions we may decide to keep int4 on short-context routes and only promote to long-context after more tuning. :thumbsup:
